⚠️ Traffic Advisory ⚠️

Ross Avenue between Industry Way and Dogwood Avenue will be closed to all vehicular traffic beginning Saturday, May 16 through Sunday, May 17 due to planned roadway operations.

Detour Route:
Ross Avenue → Industry Way → Heil Avenue → Ross Avenue

Motorists are encouraged to plan ahead, allow extra travel time, reduce speed near the work zone, and follow all posted detour signs. Emergency vehicle access will be maintained at all times.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your patience and cooperation.

Stay up to date with traffic alerts, emergencies, road closures, and more through the City of El Centro’s free Mass Notification System. Sign up below.

For additional information, please contact the City of El Centro Public Works Department at (760) 337-5182.
#WeAreElCentro

⚠️ Aviso de Tráfico ⚠️

La avenida Ross entre Industry Way y Dogwood Avenue estará cerrada al tráfico vehicular a partir del sábado 16 de mayo hasta el domingo 17 de mayo debido a trabajos programados en la vialidad.

Ruta de desvío:
Ross Avenue → Industry Way → Heil Avenue → Ross Avenue

Se recomienda a los automovilistas planificar con anticipación, considerar tiempo adicional de traslado, reducir la velocidad cerca de la zona de trabajo y seguir toda la señalización de desvío. El acceso para vehículos de emergencia se mantendrá en todo momento.

Pedimos disculpas por cualquier inconveniente que esto pueda causar y agradecemos su paciencia y cooperación.

Manténgase al día con alertas de tráfico, emergencias, cierres de calles y más a través del Sistema Gratuito de Notificaciones Masivas de la Ciudad de El Centro. Regístrese abajo.

Para más información, comuníquese con el Departamento de Obras Públicas de la Ciudad de El Centro al (760) 337-5182.
#SomosElCentro

Before THE FURIOUS, there was FURIOUS!

1984's 'Furious' is the first film to star brothers Simon and Phillip Rhee (4 years before the pair found the greener pastures of Hollywood in the 'Best of the Best' franchise), both of whom hold Black Belts in Taekwondo and Hapkido. The rest of the film’s cast consists mostly of the Rhees’ own students and friends, including an early appearance by Loren Avedon (No Retreat, No Surrender II). Also appearing is former World Kickboxing Champion, Howard Jackson (Code of Silence), former Miss Philippines, Arlene Montano (L.A. Streetfighters) as well as a quick cameo by Susanna Hoffs (of the popular 80s band, The Bangles).

Read more about this insane martial arts film: https://t.co/s2umqZxdk7
